name: Reschedule appointment
description: Move an existing appointment to a new date and time.

slots.name: appointment_id
slots.prompt: Of course. What is the appointment reference? It looks like APT-2231.
slots.retry_prompt: I need the appointment reference, for example APT-2231.

slots.name: date
slots.prompt: What new date would you like?
slots.retry_prompt: I could not read that date. Try next Friday or 2026-11-10.

slots.name: time
slots.prompt: What new time works for you?

nodes.prompt: Move ${slots.appointment_id} to ${slots.date} at ${slots.time}. Is that right?
